scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @url-checker/api" "npm run dev -w @url-checker/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @url-checker/api && npm run build -w @url-checker/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @url-checker/api && npm run typecheck -w @url-checker/web
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test -w @url-checker/api && npm run test -w @url-checker/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:e2e -w @url-checker/api
scripts.architecture: npm run architecture:eslint && npm run architecture:steiger
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run architecture && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
